entries.root_cause: The trusted issue_comment workflow materialized only the implementation-scope wrapper while the wrapper resolved its shared scope core relative to its own temporary location. Real scope attestation therefore failed at import time instead of evaluating the candidate.

The structural persistence-write detector recognized only direct known receiver spellings and an incomplete bracket-member shape. Aliasing a persistence receiver or using quoted computed-member invocation could perform G2-owned writes while semantic scope still passed.

Raw-secret data-flow protection relied on a short sink vocabulary and therefore missed ordinary API response methods such as reply.send. A raw provider credential could be returned to the browser without matching the structural exposure fence.

Structural SQL hardening enumerated TABLE and SCHEMA but did not treat all DDL object classes as forbidden G2-owned persistence authority. CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW could therefore modify the shared Monitoring schema from a non-SQL artifact.
horizontal_audit: index sequence type function procedure trigger extension policy

entries.root_cause: Identifier component splitting handled lower-to-upper camel boundaries but not acronym-to-Pascal transitions. Conventional names such as METRICSRepository therefore collapsed into one component and evaded forbidden metric-family matching in code and paths.

The authorized browser-automation exception was exact-identifier-only. Legitimate browser E2E phrases and compound test identifiers still exposed an automation component and were falsely rejected despite being explicitly inside G2 authority.
